text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is hurt. She looked like
she was in
a lot of pain when she got
injured, but now...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Doctor. I feel good as new.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You must be feeling better if you
can smile
like that. Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer? There's nothing to worry
about.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A mascot's job is to create smiles. I won't
do
anything that'll cause you concern.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I know. How about I show you I'm fine
with a short
run? What could be more
reassuring than seeing
it with your own
eyes?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I know. How about I show you I'm fine
with a short
run? What could be more
reassuring than seeing
it with your own
eyes?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All right, if you think that's best for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll heal up nice and quick so I can get
back to
training. I'm on-the-mend
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, time for me to go night night. Bye,
now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Now, behold the unstoppable
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A wise person once said there's a fine
line
between bravery and recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I don't want to be known as the
mascot of
recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's realized she'll only worry
me more if
she keeps going. At any rate,
she heads back to
the dorm of her own
accord.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... That doctor really fixed me up. In
this
condition, I should be able to run
with no trouble
at all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I should go back to the infirmary to say

thanks—with a Machan smile, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan overcomes her injury with
a smile.
She should be back to full speed
in no time.
